transcription.locator: 8. Monitoring Agency; revised paragraph and attached footnote
transcription.amountSentence: Based on the Price Band of ₹ 51 to ₹ 54 per Equity Share, the Issue size would aggregate to ₹ 4,792.98 lakhs at the Floor Price and ₹ 5,074.92 lakhs at the Cap Price*.
transcription.qualificationText: *Calculated on the basis of up to 93,98,000 Equity Shares offered in the Issue and subject to finalisation of the Basis of Allotment.
transcription.supersessionText: the Price Band has been revised from ₹ 50 to ₹ 53 per Equity Share to ₹ 51 to ₹ 54 per Equity Share.

value.qualification: Based on up to 93,98,000 shares; subject to finalisation of the Basis of Allotment.
